instruction: The task is to be completed with command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `fulladd.ipc2581` and `placement_rules.json` are on the desktop. Place the board and save the result. Requirements: - Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. And `placement.csv`. - `placement.csv` must list `Reference,X_mm,Y_mm,Side,Rotation` for every placed component. - The placed IPC-2581 file must preserve the original nets and layers. - Honor the requested grid and minimum center-to-center keepout. For `compact_top_side`, put every component on TOP and make the component-center bounding-box area smaller than in the source board. [Software] the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
